name: 59911 · Bigfork, MT
findings: ZIP 59911 (Bigfork) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59911 (Bigfork) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
